**Tool name**:

**Where its usage is visible today** (web console, CLI output, notification — say where you
personally see the numbers):

**Is there an official API or CLI command that reports usage?** Name it and link the
documentation if it exists. This matters more than anything else: a provider that can run the
vendor's own CLI, or use an API key the user owns, is straightforward; one that would have to
read undocumented token files or unofficial endpoints needs a much closer look.
